stages.text: Board your courier at the dock (step on the portal, press G) and leave Kestrel Reach.

one_way_message.text: First segment decodes: 'If you're reading this, you left the station - good. Don't file a flight plan.' Board your courier at the dock (step on the portal, press G).

stages.text: The note names a dead relay in the Tessellate system - jump there.

one_way_message.text: Next segment decodes, in Elian's own words: 'Tessellate. The old relay station - it still holds air, and someone still lives in it. Ask them about the survey.' Pick Tessellate on the star map and jump (V).

stages.text: Dock at the Tessellate relay station.

one_way_message.text: The relay's on a slow tumble but the dock still lights up. Match it and set down (L).

stages.text: Find the archivist who knew Elian and hear what they have.

one_way_message.text: The segment after that: 'Whoever's keeping the relay logs knew me. They kept the last thing I sent back. Read it before you decide anything.'

stages.text: The note's last line points past the edge - jump to the Verge.

one_way_message.text: Final segment, and it isn't a place: 'If it's still talking when you get there, it isn't me anymore. Come anyway. The Verge - the moon with the settlement. I'll have left the light on.'

stages.text: Land at the settlement on the Verge moon.

one_way_message.text: There's one settled moon in the Verge and one lit pad on it. Set down.
The file's fully decoded now. Whatever's on the far side of the plaza, you came a long way to hear it out.
